rationale: The affected server-sent-event fragment rendering feature is absent: every LedgerCore controller returns JSON records, Problem Details or a stored JSON result. No SseEmitter, ResponseBodyEmitter, FragmentsRendering or fragment-view configuration is used.

The affected XsltView is neither configured nor referenced. LedgerCore is a REST JSON backend with Swagger static resources; untrusted clients cannot choose or construct an XSLT view. A framework major migration is not used as a substitute for assessing applicability.
evidence: ArchitectureTest.unusedVulnerableViewFeaturesCannotBeIntroduced and absence of XSLT configuration in application resources; https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GHSA-pc63-qcmh-9cmg
